title: Enterprise Deployment - Chief of Staff
location: United States, New York, San Francisco
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
HOW WE WORK
 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
As Chief of Staff, you’ll work closely with our Field CTO and Enterprise Deployment leads and be responsible for managing their teams’ workflow, understanding not only the business opportunities but the individual skills of their people. You’ll bring organization to this fast-growing team, constantly improving efficiencies and will gain a holistic overview of the Enterprise Deployment team, with leaders able to lean on you and trust your advice..
As Chief of Staff you should expect to:
 - Become an expert on the strengths of the Enterprise Deployment team members and staff them on projects thoughtfully, based on geography, priorities, capacity and skills.
 - Use this expertise to track performance of team members, engaging with their leads and people they work closely with to gain a full understanding of performance
 - Coordinate recruitment and hiring with the internal Talent team, making sure we’re focusing on key roles and locations and ensuring interviewing is appropriately shared amongst the Enterprise Deployment team.
 - Own the onboarding process. As we continue to hire at a rapid pace, you should ensure that each new team member is ready to go from Day 1 and that they have all the resources they need to ramp up rapidly.
 - Prepare for team meetings by co-ordinating with meeting leads, preparing slides where needed and crucially, making sure the time spent in these meetings is useful and effective for all attendees.
 - Track the Enterprise Deployment OKRs and provide regular updates on their progress, spotting issues or gaps in coverage early.
 - Plan team co-locations - with a team spreading across the globe, we want to regularly bring our people together to strengthen partnerships and encourage collaboration.
 - Act as the liaison between the deployment team and other parts of the organisation to ensure coordinated alignment.
Location
This role is remote and can be executed globally but London, England is preferred.
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Product Manager, Storage
description:
About Vercel:
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. 
 About the Role:
 We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Vercel cloud product team. You will own the Storage product portfolio where applications and agents keep their data on Vercel. That covers Blob for blob storage, Drives for persistent filesystems, and future database and key value storage products. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, and you’ll report to the Product Lead.
 If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.
 What You Will Do:
 Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Vercel’s storage portfolio (blob storage, persistent filesystems, database, and key/value storage).
 Ensure storage products integrate seamlessly with the rest of Vercel’s cloud (Functions, backend services, Sandboxes, Daemons) to enable fully functional applications and agents.
 Set and hold the bar for performance, availability, and durability across the portfolio, and make the call when those goals trade off against speed or cost.
 Shape pricing and packaging for storage so it scales with customers from hobbyist to large Enterprises.
 Partner with Engineering, Design, and DX to ship primitives that other Vercel product teams build on.
 Work directly with Enterprise customers and the field to unblock adoption on scale, compliance, and data locality and encryption requirements.
 Use usage, performance, and reliability data to decide what to build next and what to stop doing.
 About You:
 You’ve shipped storage, database, or data infrastructure products, such as object storage, relational databases, or key-value stores.
 You can go deep on each storage solution and their tradeoffs, and explain them clearly to engineers and customers.
 You’ve owned multiple connected product areas and set direction that other product teams built against.
 You’ve worked directly with Enterprise customers on data and storage requirements and turned them into roadmap decisions.
 Bonus If You:
 Have worked at cloud provider or data storage provider.
 Have an engineering background or have built software yourself.
 Have experience with compliance and security requirements in enterprise procurement.
 Compensation & Benefits:
 Competitive compensation package, including equity.
 Inclusive Healthcare Package.
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
 Flexible Time Off.
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Disclosures: 
 Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.
 Equal Opportunity:  Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices.
### **About the Role**
Taktile is building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions with AI across customer onboarding, credit underwriting, anti money laundering, and many other use cases.
Underneath every one of these decisions sits the Taktile Platform: the permissions, environments, deployment, extensibility and connectivity foundations that allow the largest financial institutions to run Taktile securely and at scale, for both humans and AI agents. Taktile Platform also owns developer productivity: the tooling, infrastructure and workflows that help our engineering teams ship quickly and safely. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the platform, with a focus on its enterprise and agentic foundations. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure and security engineering to meet the demands of a rapidly growing enterprise customer base, and partner with customer-facing teams and Product Marketing to make our platform a reason customers choose Taktile.
### **What You’ll Do**
* Own the strategy and long-term success of the Taktile Platform, the foundation that every product area and every enterprise customer builds on
* Define a compelling long-term vision for the platform and prioritize the roadmap necessary to reach it. Example areas of focus will include permissions for users and AI agents, Taktile MCP extensibility, release processes (e.g. environments), enterprise connectivity, and more
* Build a deep understanding of enterprise requirements (security, IT, compliance and procurement), the competitive landscape and opportunities for differentiation, collaborating with customer-facing teams
* Translate customer insights into well thought out product requirements
* Balance innovation with a very high bar for reliability and security
* Act as the voice of the platform: enable and advocate for platform capabilities across product, engineering and go-to-market teams, and partner with Product Marketing to bring them to market
* Track adoption and performance of platform capabilities through metrics and customer feedback, identifying opportunities for iteration
### **Who You Are**
* 5+ yrs work experience in Product Management, including previous experience owning platform topics (e.g. identity and access management, permissions, environments, deployment models, connectivity or developer platforms) for B2B SaaS or AI products
* Strong technical depth and an appetite to keep deepening it. An engineering or other technical background is preferred. You are comfortable going deep with engineers on cloud infrastructure, authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth, SSO, SCIM) and networking. Experience in building critical, high-availability systems is a strong plus
* Experience working with enterprise security, IT and compliance stakeholders, for example through security reviews, RFPs or complex customer deployments. Familiarity with AI agents and MCP is a must, familiarity with and with financial services is desired
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to build trust and influence decisions across functions, and to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike
* Track record of delivering lasting customer impact through shipping well-thought out product improvements
* Aptitude and appetite for using data to inform your decision-making
* Hands-on, curious, and willing to challenge yourself and grow your scope of responsibilities over time
### **Our Offer**
* Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to make an impact and meaningfully impact a critical area of our product
* Experience a flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo
* Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe including the founders of Looker, Datadog, GitHub, and UiPath
* Enjoy annual offsites where the entire company co-locates to collaborate in person
* Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package as well as access to a self-development budget
* Work at our prime office locations in Berlin or London for three days per week or more
### **Our Stance**
* We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply
* We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears
**About Us**
Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. title: Associate Product Manager, Salesforce (6-7 months Maternity Cover) (all genders)
Product Owner
description:
Technical Product Owner – Release & Betrieb (m/w/d) 
 Berlin-Mitte · Hybrid · bis 90.000 € p. a. · unbefristet
 Wenn hier ein Update schiefgeht, merkt es zuerst die Ärztin um 7 Uhr auf Station. Deshalb ist Release und Betrieb bei diesem Produkt kein Nebenschauplatz, sondern eine eigene Produktverantwortung — und genau die suchen wir.
 Worum es geht 
 Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Berliner Softwarehaus für Kliniken. Das Produkt läuft nicht in der Cloud, sondern in mehreren hundert individuell konfigurierten Installationen unter Windows und Linux direkt beim Kunden. Installation, Update und Betrieb sind damit ein Produkt für sich, mit eigenem Backlog und eigener Roadmap.
 Du übernimmst diese technische Seite der Produktverantwortung — im Tandem mit einer Kollegin, die den fachlichen Teil der Anwendung verantwortet. Das Entwicklungsteam umfasst 14 Leute, aufgeteilt in Angular-Frontend und Java-Backend.
 Was du gestaltest 
 Du baust die Installations- und Update-Strecken über CI/CD so um, dass Releases planbar werden statt nervenaufreibend. Du legst Versionierung und Rollback-Strategien fest, entscheidest, wenn Entwicklung, Support, QM und Kunde in unterschiedliche Richtungen ziehen, und gestaltest KI-gestützte Funktionen mit, die im Klinikalltag ankommen: Patientenakten automatisiert auslesen, Arztbriefe erzeugen, Abrechnungen prüfen.
 Der regulierte Rahmen ist dabei kein Bremsklotz, sondern Teil der Aufgabe — und der Grund, warum diese Rolle Gewicht hat.
 Was du mitbringst 
 Du hast als Product Owner, Technical PO, Release oder Delivery Manager gearbeitet und kennst Windows Server und Linux aus dem Betrieb, nicht nur vom Diagramm. Du hast CI/CD-Pipelines aufgesetzt oder betreut, egal ob Azure DevOps, Jenkins oder GitLab, und arbeitest mit Docker. Java-Code liest du sicher genug, um Änderungen einzuordnen, und Datenbanken samt Migrationen sind dir nicht fremd. Deutsch auf C1-Niveau brauchst du, weil die Fachsprache im Gesundheitswesen deutsch ist.
 Schön, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, mit ISO 13485, MDR oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld. Das lernst du hier. Und wenn dir zwei, drei Punkte fehlen: bewirb dich trotzdem, wir schauen uns das gemeinsam an.
 Was du bekommst 
 Bis zu 90.000 € im Jahr, unbefristet, zwei bis drei Tage Homeoffice, Büro in Berlin-Mitte. Ein Produkt mit echter installierter Basis statt Runway-Risiko, kurze Wege zum CTO und ein Haus, das seine Anwender jedes Jahr zum eigenen Symposium einlädt — weil es sie kennt.
 Wie es weitergeht 
 Zwei Schritte: ein Videocall, danach ein Tag im Team vor Ort. Du siehst die Leute, bevor du dich entscheidest.

title: Senior Product Manager - Parental Leave Cover (Fixed-Term, 12 Months)
description:
About Staffbase
 We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform . Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.
Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we're shaping the future of workplace communication.
At Staffbase, we're moving beyond communication into a new frontier: helping millions of frontline and deskless employees not just find information, but actually get things done . The Actions team owns that execution layer - the bridge between employees, Staffbase AI, and the real operational work happening in stores, warehouses, hospitals, and in the field.
Our biggest bet right now is Tasks - the product that lets an enterprise's HQ push operational standards to thousands of locations and see them executed on the ground, driven by a major new partnership. Around it sits a portfolio of agentic actions, forms, and HR workflows that make Staffbase a place where work happens, not just where it's announced.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to seize this moment. This is a 12-month fixed-term role - and we mean that as a feature. It's a rare chance to make an outsized, visible impact on Staffbase's expansion into operational territory, with senior leadership attention and real revenue behind it, without signing up for the long corporate haul. If you're a builder who loves 0-to-1 energy and wants to point it at a concrete, high-stakes problem for a year, this is for you.
You're a commercially-minded generalist, comfortable in ambiguity, fast-moving, and able to hold the whole picture - customer, business case, and build - in your head at once.
 What you'll be doing
 Own Tasks as your primary focus - shaping it from an early build into a solution that scales to thousands of frontline locations, and driving the roadmap and prioritization calls
 Partner with an operational-retail domain expert and our internal solution designers to turn a complex real-world problem into the right solution on the Staffbase foundation
 Work directly with flagship enterprise customers - talking eye-to-eye about their operational reality and turning it into product
 Keep the wider Actions surface healthy - forms, HR actions, and the existing widget/plugin estate - steering maintenance priorities with the Actions Core team rather than owning the backlog yourself
 Define what success looks like for operational products: adoption by busy frontline workers first, corporate reporting second
 Bring an AI-native lens throughout - where an intelligent layer genuinely unblocks a worker, and where it's just noise
 Help land open strategic calls (e.g. how deeply Tasks integrates into the core vs. lives as a plugin) with senior stakeholders
 What you need to be successful
 5+ years in product management, with a strong commercial / business orientation - you think in customer value and outcomes, not just features
 A genuine generalist who owns products end-to-end across discovery, delivery, GTM, and stakeholders
 You thrive in ambiguity and greenfield - you'd rather shape a fuzzy new problem than optimize a mature one
 B2B SaaS background - you understand enterprise customers and what it takes to roll something out at scale
 Fast and pragmatic under a real deadline, without losing the end user
 Confident and opinionated - you hold your own with a senior engineering team on priorities and with leadership on strategy
 AI-native in how you work and how you think about the product
 Highly desirable
 Exposure to deskless / frontline or operational-workflow products (task management, retail/hospitality ops, field service)
 Hands-on understanding of the action surfaces we work with - Microsoft 365 actions, ServiceNow, HRIS or task-management products specifically
 Experience taking a product from early build into scaled enterprise rollout
 Familiarity with permissions / hierarchy models (who creates, assigns, and executes across an org) - a core challenge here
 What you'll get 
 Competitive Compensation - we offer an attractive salary
 Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
 Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
 Volunteers Day - you'll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

title: Founders Associate - Sales & Go-to-Market (m/w/d)
description:
Du bist die erste Person auf dieser Rolle und baust den Sales-Motor von egora direkt mit den Gründern auf. Faires Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision: du verdienst an jedem Deal mit, der aus deinen Übergaben entsteht.
**Über egora:**
egora revolutioniert, wie Firmen deutschlandweit Catering organisieren. Als investorengebacktes Start-up wachsen wir rasant und verbinden Unternehmen wie Databricks, GetYourGuide oder Audible mit den besten 150+ Caterern der Stadt. Einfach, schnell, 100 % Full-Service. Mit an Bord: Top-Investoren hinter Marken wie Helpling, meinFernbus und Home24. Unsere Software ist das Herzstück, unterstützt von KI, kuratierten Angeboten und einem persönlichen Service, den unsere Kunden lieben.
**Aufgaben**
------------
Was du bei uns machst
* Du weckst schlafende Business-Accounts auf: Firmen, die schon über egora gebucht haben, aber nicht aktiv betreut werden. Du findest den Entscheider und bringst sie zurück.
* Du verkaufst unser Daily-Lunch-Angebot und legst Termine mit Entscheidern, damit unsere Account Manager nie leere Kalender haben.
* Du gewinnst neue Unternehmen für egora und findest kreative Wege rein, wo andere aufgeben.
* Du spielst saisonale Chancen aktiv: Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerfeste, Team-Events.
* Du qualifizierst deine Accounts und übergibst sauber an unser Team. Du öffnest die Türen, deine Kolleg:innen betreuen, du verdienst am Ergebnis mit.
* Du arbeitest täglich mit HubSpot, Apollo und KI-Tools, dem modernsten Sales-Stack, den du je hattest.
**Qualifikation**
-----------------
Wen wir suchen
* Du bist am Anfang deiner Karriere und hast mehr Hunger als Geduld. Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg ist uns egal, aber du hast schon irgendwo gezeigt, dass du Dinge zu Ende bringst.
* Du willst lernen, wie man ein Unternehmen aufbaut, und zwar am Umsatz, nicht an Slides.
* Menschenfänger:in: warm, empathisch, eloquent, am Telefon wie schriftlich.
* Keine Angst vor Neins: Du rufst den Geschäftsführer an, nicht die Info-Adresse.
* Hartnäckig, ohne aufdringlich zu sein. Du fasst nach, wo andere aufgeben, und spürst, wann Zurückhaltung klüger ist.
* Du willst über Leistung verdienen. Wenn dich ungedeckelte Provision elektrisiert statt verunsichert, bist du hier richtig.
* Deutsch verhandlungssicher. Catering-Erfahrung brauchst du nicht: Drive kann man nicht lernen, Catering schon.
**Wo das hinführt**
Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle. Du baust den Outbound-Motor, mit dem Volumen kommt dein eigenes Team, und beim Deutschland-Rollout brauchen wir jemanden, der Sales führt. Nach oben gibt es keine Decke, weil das Team gerade erst entsteht. Wie schnell, entscheidest du.
**Benefits**
------------
Was du bekommst
* Ungedeckelte Provision, dein Einkommen hat kein Limit.
* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründerteam, jeden Tag.
* Top-moderne Ausstattung (MacBook, Noise-Cancelling-Headset etc.).
* Hybrides Arbeiten im Herzen von Berlin.
* Verantwortung ab Tag 1.
Klingt nach dir? Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil, wir melden uns schnell. Im zweiten Schritt stellen wir dir 4 kurze Fragen.

title: Program Manager, AMZL Launch & Expansion
description:
Description
 Our Program Manager's are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. As a Program Manager, pioneering new ways of thinking, designing and delivering is your mission. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis, always with an eye on the long-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.
Key job responsibilities
 Create innovative solutions using data and research to address wider challenges in your organization
 Take a big-picture approach in your analysis of business operations, driving improvements across a range of teams and organizations
 Work alongside senior leadership to establish and prioritize improvement programs, seeing them through from start to finish
 Enhance operational performance on every program in partnership with your stakeholders
 A day in the life
As a Program Manager, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programs. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. Some managers are based on-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.
Program Managers have significant responsibilities, and you’ll deal with complex challenges with creativity, innovation, and leadership. With a responsibility extending beyond process improvements, you could also contribute to improving other areas of the business, like diversity, equity, and inclusion.
 About The Team
 When you click on your screen, and know that your Amazon parcel will arrive with you on the next day, you’ve just use one of the world’s most sophisticated fulfillment networks. At AMZL Europe, we deliver millions of packages daily to customers at record speed and quality. The work that Launch and Expansion do is at the heart of that. Our relentless ambition is to make AMZL Europe more and more cost-effective and customer centric. We’re doing that by improving our existing network, inventing new and creative ways of making last-mile delivery more efficient, and optimizing the development of our Under the Roof and On Road Infrastructure. Within the team we have a variety of roles. Typical examples include program managers responsible for selecting and launching new sites, planners working out how we solve challenges such as low emission zones and EV charging, strategy teams looking at how we get the most out of our existing buildings, and analysts using data to deliver insights into how we work and how we should be working.
Help plan the future of the biggest last mile delivery network in Europe
Select, build and launch huge buildings and infrastructure with multi-million dollar budgets
Make decisions that shape Amazon’s fulfillment strategy across the globe
Work at the forefront of logistics innovation
 Basic Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree
 Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
 Experience in program or project management
 Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
 Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
 Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
 Experience leading process improvements
 Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
 Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. title: Senior Product Manager, Home and Community (Remote)
description:
For those who want to invent the future of health care, here's your opportunity. We're going beyond basic care to health programs integrated across the entire continuum of care. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together.
 Join our Home & Community team as a Sr. Product Manager, leading the strategy, development, and performance of key healthcare capabilities. This role owns products end-to-end, translating business needs into product roadmaps, requirements, and scalable technology solutions while partnering closely with business, operations, and technology teams.
The ideal candidate is a strategic product leader with experience delivering healthcare products in complex, matrixed organizations. Success in this role requires expertise in product development, stakeholder management, agile delivery, roadmap prioritization, and driving measurable business outcomes. You will serve as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring solutions align with organizational goals and customer needs.
You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.
 Primary Responsibilities
 Owns new development, deployment, and performance of their defined capabilities, leading and managing capability(ies) end-to-end
 Decomposes initiatives into defined deliverables, product features, and business and technical requirements
 Defines and prioritizes deliverables into a business-level roadmap, ensuring consistent communication and alignment across cross-functional stakeholders
 Develops use cases, business and technical requirements, and workflows for new features by soliciting feedback across H&C and our customers
 Acts as primary source for capability detail and priorities for cross functional partners, ensuring understanding and appropriate prioritization; owner of the backlog with capability owners and engineering
 Understands, defines, and prioritizes capability vision into business roadmap; manages scope and requirement changes that occur during development
 Defines success metrics and performance manages capabilities to those metrics, ensuring KPIs and associated reporting are embedded in everything we do
 Collaborates with technology to document technical vision, requirements, and communicate solutions
 Owns work plans to deliver, including resource allocation, risk management, and issue resolution
 Assesses technology solution options and decisions, ensuring alignment across business and technology stakeholders to end goals and mitigating business risks
 Oversees operational readiness planning, participates in UAT and prioritizes defects
 Monitors budget and delivery progress, provides consistent visibility into work to stakeholders
 Understands and facilitate end-to-end solutions and system integration needs
 You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.
 Required Qualifications
 6 + years of experience leading capability enablement and product development in a large-scale, highly matrixed team environment
 Healthcare experience required with experience in delivering new initiatives and products within the healthcare domain
 Experience working with AHA and Rally
 Experience with SAFe , LeSS or similar frameworks
 Demonstrated experience in verbal and written communications and presentations at the executive level
 Demonstrated ability to work with business leaders and enable strategy execution 
 All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy
 Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $112,700 - $193,200 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.
 Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.
 At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
 UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.
 UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.
